text.p: These are the leading stories in the official Syrian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Syrian President Hafez al-Assad's briefed by Vice-President Abdel-Halim Khaddam and Foreign Minister Farouq al-Shara on their mission to Saudi Arabia and Kuwait.
- Khaddam hands Assad's message on latest developments in the Middle East to Sheikh Zaid bin Sultan al-Nahayan and says Syria accepts resuming peace talks.
- Shara confers with EU envoy Miguel Angel Moratinos and discusses the Middle East peace talks and the European role.
- (Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin) Netanyahu insists on resuming peace talks with Syria from the "zero point" and renews Israel's security pretexts.
- Syrian cabinet discusses ways to improve exports and the general agriculture situation.
- A new conference on Arab-European ties will be held in Brussels between February 26-28.
